businessType: Small local real-estate agency (賃貸・売買仲介). First contact is a property or condition inquiry; the conversion goal is a viewing (内見) or in-store consultation request that staff confirm by hand.

customerIntents.evidence: 物件や条件について問い合わせ・相談ができる
内見の予約リクエストができる
店舗へのアクセスがわかる
営業時間と定休日がわかる

commonLineUseCases: 物件・条件についてのお問い合わせ（空室確認・家賃・初期費用など）
内見予約リクエスト（スタッフが物件側と調整のうえ確定連絡）
来店相談予約リクエスト
会社・店舗情報、アクセス、営業時間の確認
物件一覧は既存の自社Webサイト／ポータルへリンク（Phase 1では物件データを持たない）

SERVICES: reservation-basic-v1 の構造上シートは作成されるが、不動産では空のままでよい（serviceId は任意）
notificationRequirements: Owner email on every viewing / consultation reservation request

terminology.inquiry: 物件・条件のお問い合わせ
terminology.reservation: 内見・来店相談の予約リクエスト（確定ではありません）
terminology.capacity: 同じ時間帯に受けられる内見・相談の件数（対応できるスタッフ数）

risks: A viewing request is only a REQUESTED row. Staff must confirm the slot with the property owner/management company and set status to CONFIRMED by hand; the customer is not told it is confirmed.
reservation-basic-v1 records only a date-time. The customer cannot pick which property to view from the Rich Menu, so staff must ask by LINE/phone after the request (planned: property-viewing-v2).
The LINE reply text from createReservation@1 says 「ご予約リクエストを受け付けました」, not 「内見予約リクエスト」. It is correct (request, not confirmation) but generic.
reservation.capacity counts parallel requests, not staff or vehicles; per-agent scheduling is not supported (planned: agent-assignment-v2).
Property availability changes daily; no property data is stored in Phase 1, so answers about vacancies are given by staff manually via INQUIRIES.
assumptions: The agency already publishes its property list on its own website or a portal; the Rich Menu links to it instead of storing properties.
Viewing and in-store consultation share one reservation-basic-v1 flow; staff tell them apart from the follow-up conversation.
Opening hours follow the common real-estate pattern (水曜定休).
Requirement not mapped to a Phase 1 workflow (needs manual review): "物件一覧は既存のWebサイトで見られるようにしたい"

implemented: inquiry-basic-v1: 物件・条件のお問い合わせ
reservation-basic-v1: 内見・来店相談の予約リクエスト（REQUESTED のみ）
business-info-v1: 会社・店舗情報 / アクセス / 営業時間
Rich Menu URI button to an existing property list page (links.propertySiteUrl)

planned.description: PROPERTIES sheet schema (property_catalog = deferred; no current workflow reads it).
Search/filter properties by area, rent and layout from LINE.
Flex Message card per property with photos and conditions.
Viewing request tied to a specific propertyId.
Assign a staff member per viewing; per-agent availability.

Past inquiries and viewings per customer for staff follow-up.
